lessons.title: Past verbs: person, number and gender
objectives: Understand and use the taught past verbs: person, number and gender patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Past verb ki ending person, number aur gender ki pehchan deti hai. Regular كَتَبَ model par singular ke saath dual aur plural bhi dekhen. Yeh taught regular model hai; weak aur doubled roots ki special changes ko isi table se guess na karen.
rulesRomanUrdu: Singular: هُوَ كَتَبَ، هِيَ كَتَبَتْ، أَنْتَ كَتَبْتَ، أَنْتِ كَتَبْتِ، أَنَا كَتَبْتُ.
Dual: هُمَا كَتَبَا do mard/mixed, هُمَا كَتَبَتَا do auratein; أَنْتُمَا كَتَبْتُمَا aap dono.
Plural: هُمْ كَتَبُوا، هُنَّ كَتَبْنَ، أَنْتُمْ كَتَبْتُمْ، أَنْتُنَّ كَتَبْتُنَّ، نَحْنُ كَتَبْنَا.
كَتَبُوا mein waaw ke baad alif likha jata hai lekin alag vowel ki tarah nahin parhte. Ending harakat ko person ke saath seekhen.

examples.meaningRomanUrdu: Un mardon/mixed group ne aik khat likha.
Un auraton ne aik khat likha.
Aap dono ne aik khat likha.

reading.text: أَمْسِ كَتَبْنَا رِسَالَةً فِي الْمَكْتَبِ. هُمْ كَتَبُوا الْعُنْوَانَ. هُنَّ كَتَبْنَ السُّؤَالَ. ثُمَّ قَرَأْنَا الرِّسَالَةَ مَعًا.
reading.meaningRomanUrdu: Kal hum ne office mein khat likha. Mardon/mixed group ne address aur auraton ne sawal likha. Phir hum ne khat saath parha.

lessons.title: Present verbs and the five forms
objectives: Understand and use the taught present verbs and the five forms patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Mudari verb mein prefixes ke saath endings bhi person aur number batati hain. A1 ke singular forms ke baad ab dual, male/mixed plural aur feminine plural ko alag pehchanen. Afal khamsa naam paanch patterns ke liye hai, sirf paanch dictionary verbs ke liye nahin.
rulesRomanUrdu: Singular/first plural: أَكْتُبُ، نَكْتُبُ، يَكْتُبُ، تَكْتُبُ; context se she/you masculine ka farq hota hai.
Paanch indicative patterns: يَكْتُبَانِ، تَكْتُبَانِ، يَكْتُبُونَ، تَكْتُبُونَ، تَكْتُبِينَ. Yahan noon retained hai.
أَنْتُنَّ تَكْتُبْنَ aur هُنَّ يَكْتُبْنَ feminine plural hain; in ka noon afal khamsa ka noon nahin.
أَنْ ya لَمْ ke baad afal khamsa endings badalti hain; un ki applied mood practice B1 mein hogi.

reading.text: الطَّالِبَانِ يَكْتُبَانِ فِي الصَّبَاحِ. أَنْتُمْ تَكْتُبُونَ فِي الْمَسَاءِ. هُنَّ يَكْتُبْنَ هُنَا. نَحْنُ نَقْرَأُ بَعْدَ الدَّرْسِ.
reading.meaningRomanUrdu: Do male students subah likhte hain. Aap group shaam likhte hain. Woh auratein yahan likhti hain. Hum sabaq ke baad parhte hain.

lessons.title: Form II: teaching and repeated patterns
objectives: Understand and use the taught form ii: teaching and repeated patterns patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Root ke huroof aur verb ka pattern dono meaning mein hissa lete hain. Form II mein middle radical par shaddah aam pehchan hai: دَرَّسَ / يُدَرِّسُ. Form II kabhi causative ya repeated/intensive maani deta hai lekin har root ka naya verb khud banana sahi nahin; asal vocabulary meaning seekhen.
rulesRomanUrdu: دَرَسَ us ne study kiya; دَرَّسَ us ne parhaya. Shaddah maani ka farq hai.
عَلَّمَ / يُعَلِّمُ teach aur نَظَّمَ / يُنَظِّمُ organize ki taught vocabulary hai.
Present pattern mein shuru vowel damma aur middle kasra dekhen: يُدَرِّسُ.
Root family sirf learning aid hai; usage/transitivity aur exact meaning dictionary/review se verify hote hain.

reading.text: تُدَرِّسُ سَارَةُ الْعَرَبِيَّةَ. فِي الصَّبَاحِ تُعَلِّمُ الطُّلَّابَ كَلِمَاتٍ جَدِيدَةً. بَعْدَ الدَّرْسِ تُنَظِّمُ الْكُتُبَ. خَالِدٌ يَدْرُسُ هُنَا وَلَا يُدَرِّسُ.
reading.meaningRomanUrdu: Sara Arabic parhati hai. Subah students ko naye words sikhati aur baad mein kitaaben tartib deti hai. Khalid yahan student ki tarah parhta hai, parhata nahin.

lessons.title: Forms III and IV in common words
objectives: Understand and use the taught forms iii and iv in common words patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Form III aur IV ki pehchan common real verbs se karen. شَارَكَ / يُشَارِكُ participate aur أَرْسَلَ / يُرْسِلُ send hain. Pattern meaning ka ishara de sakta hai, lekin har Form III mutual aur har Form IV causative hona lazmi nahin.
rulesRomanUrdu: Form III فَاعَلَ mein pehle radical ke baad long aa hoti hai: شَارَكَ.
سَاعَدَ / يُسَاعِدُ help ek aur common Form III pair hai.
Form IV أَفْعَلَ / يُفْعِلُ ki pehchan: أَرْسَلَ / يُرْسِلُ.
Present mein Form IV ka shuru hamza alag word ki tarah nahin rehta: yursilu. Exact marked pair ko vocabulary ke saath yaad karen.

examples.meaningRomanUrdu: Khalid ne lesson mein participate kiya.
Woh female student ki madad karti hai.

reading.text: شَارَكَ خَالِدٌ فِي دَرْسٍ جَدِيدٍ. سَاعَدَ طَالِبًا، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ رِسَالَةً إِلَى الْمُعَلِّمِ. فِي الْمَسَاءِ يُرْسِلُ الْمُعَلِّمُ جَوَابًا.
reading.meaningRomanUrdu: Khalid ne naye lesson mein hissa liya, aik student ki madad ki aur teacher ko message bheja. Shaam teacher jawab bhejta hai.

lessons.title: Forms V and VI: learning and cooperation
objectives: Understand and use the taught forms v and vi: learning and cooperation patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Form V mein ta prefix aur middle shaddah milti hai: تَعَلَّمَ / يَتَعَلَّمُ learned/learns. Form VI mein ta aur long aa: تَعَاوَنَ / يَتَعَاوَنُ cooperated/cooperates. Pattern pehchan meaning ke saath seekhen; invented root forms na banayen.
rulesRomanUrdu: عَلَّمَ teach aur تَعَلَّمَ learn ka subject role alag hai.
تَعَلَّمْتُ main ne seekha aur أَتَعَلَّمُ main seekhta/seekhti hoon.
تَعَاوَنَ cooperation ka real vocabulary item hai; mutual meaning yahan relevant hai.
Prefix aur shaddah ko teacher/learner ke meaning se joren; صرف pattern dekhna full comprehension nahin.

examples.meaningRomanUrdu: Woh sikhati hai aur main seekhta/seekhti hoon.

reading.text: أَتَعَلَّمُ الْعَرَبِيَّةَ فِي الْمَكْتَبَةِ. الْمُعَلِّمَةُ تُعَلِّمُ كَلِمَاتٍ جَدِيدَةً. نَحْنُ نَتَعَاوَنُ فِي الْمَجْمُوعَةِ. كُلُّ طَالِبٍ يَقْرَأُ جُمْلَةً.
reading.meaningRomanUrdu: Main library mein Arabic seekhta/seekhti hoon. Female teacher naye words sikhati hai. Hum group mein cooperate karte hain aur har student aik sentence parhta hai.

lessons.title: More derived forms: VII, VIII and X
objectives: Understand and use the taught more derived forms: vii, viii and x patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Kuch common derived forms in- ya ista- se pehchane ja sakte hain. اِنْكَسَرَ break ho gaya, اِجْتَمَعَ met/gathered aur اِسْتَعْمَلَ used ko real vocabulary ke saath seekhen. Form number se har lafz ka meaning mechanically nahin nikalta.
rulesRomanUrdu: Form VII اِنْكَسَرَ / يَنْكَسِرُ: yahan cheez tootne ka result hai.
Form VIII اِجْتَمَعَ / يَجْتَمِعُ: log milte/jama hote hain.
Form X اِسْتَعْمَلَ / يَسْتَعْمِلُ: use karna. Har Form X request ka meaning nahin deta.
In verbs ke initial alif hamzat al-wasl wale hain; complete phonetic/morphological exceptions ka review baad mein hoga.

reading.text: اِجْتَمَعَ الطُّلَّابُ فِي الْمَكْتَبَةِ. اِسْتَعْمَلَ خَالِدٌ كِتَابًا جَدِيدًا. اِنْكَسَرَ قَلَمٌ، فَاسْتَعْمَلَ قَلَمًا آخَرَ. ثُمَّ بَدَأَ الدَّرْسُ.
reading.meaningRomanUrdu: Students library mein mile. Khalid ne nayi kitaab use ki. Aik qalam toot gaya, is liye us ne doosra qalam use kiya. Phir lesson shuru hua.

lessons.title: Possession with attached pronouns
objectives: Understand and use the taught possession with attached pronouns patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Attached pronouns noun ke aakhir lag kar possession batate hain. كِتَابِي meri kitaab, كِتَابُكَ tumhari kitaab (mard), كِتَابُكِ tumhari (aurat), كِتَابُهُ us mard ki aur كِتَابُهَا us aurat ki. Noun ki outer case ending context se badal sakti hai; suffix ki pehchan ko noun case ke saath na milayen.
rulesRomanUrdu: Noun+suffix definite hota hai; in simple possessive nouns par الـ aur tanween nahin lagate.
هٰذَا كِتَابُنَا hamari kitaab hai; ـنَا us object se hamara relation batata hai.
Ta marbuta attachment par khuli taa ki tarah likhi jati hai: حَقِيبَةٌ se حَقِيبَتِي.
هٰذَا كِتَابُهُ aur فِي كِتَابِهِ mein noun case aur hu/hi vowel context badalte hain; sirf aik fixed ending har jagah na use karen.

examples.meaningRomanUrdu: Yeh us aurat ki kitaab hai.

reading.meaningRomanUrdu: Meri kitaab mere bag mein hai. Us aurat ki kitaab desk par hai. Hamari kitaab nayi hai. Hum library mein parh kar ghar lautte hain.

lessons.title: Object pronouns on verbs
objectives: Understand and use the taught object pronouns on verbs patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Verb ke aakhir object pronoun woh shakhs ya cheez ho sakta hai jis par action hota hai. قَرَأْتُهُ I read it (masculine noun), قَرَأْتُهَا I read it (feminine noun). Ending ـتُ subject I aur ـهُ/ـهَا object hain; dono roles ko alag pehchanen.
rulesRomanUrdu: كَتَبْتُ رِسَالَةً، ثُمَّ قَرَأْتُهَا: haa risaala ko refer karta hai.
قَرَأْتُ الْكِتَابَ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْتُهُ: hu kitab ko refer karta hai.
سَاعَدَنِي = us ne meri madad ki; first-person object mein noon protection bhi hai.
سَاعَدْتُهُ = main ne us mard ki madad ki. Subject aur object suffix swap karne se meaning badal jata hai.

examples.meaningRomanUrdu: Main ne usay parha: masculine object.
Main ne usay parha: feminine object.
Main ne us mard ki madad ki.

reading.text: كَتَبْتُ رِسَالَةً فِي الصَّبَاحِ. قَرَأْتُهَا، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْتُهَا إِلَى الْمُعَلِّمِ. قَرَأْتُ الْكِتَابَ أَيْضًا، وَلٰكِنْ لَمْ أُرْسِلْهُ.
reading.meaningRomanUrdu: Main ne subah message likha, parha aur teacher ko bheja. Kitaab bhi parhi lekin usay nahin bheja.

lessons.title: Pronouns after prepositions
objectives: Understand and use the taught pronouns after prepositions patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Pronoun preposition ke saath jur kar bhi relation banata hai: لِي for me, لَهُ for him, لَهَا for her; مِنِّي from me. Kuch prepositions attachment par spelling/vowel badalti hain: إِلَى se إِلَيَّ aur عَلَى se عَلَيْهِ. Original form ko simply suffix jor kar hamesha sahi nahin banaya ja sakta.
rulesRomanUrdu: فِي + هُ = فِيهِ; pehle kasra/yaa ke context mein hi sunai deta hai.
إِلَيْهِ to him aur إِلَيْهَا to her mein yaa ka spelling aur vowel pattern dekhen.
إِلَيَّ to me mein yaa doubled hai; alif maqsura wala standalone ilaa seedha retain nahin hota.
هٰذَا الْقَلَمُ لِي ownership/for-me relation batata hai. Context se translation chunein.

examples.meaningRomanUrdu: Main ne us aurat ko message bheja.

lessons.title: Idafah: connected noun phrases
objectives: Understand and use the taught idafah: connected noun phrases patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Idafah mein pehla noun doosre noun se relation banata hai: كِتَابُ الطَّالِبِ student ki kitaab. Simple possession/type idafah mein first noun par article/tanween nahin hota aur second noun genitive hota hai. First noun ka case us ke jumle ke role par depend karta hai.
rulesRomanUrdu: هٰذَا كِتَابُ الطَّالِبِ: first noun yahan -u, second -i.
قَرَأْتُ كِتَابَ الطَّالِبِ: object hone ki wajah se first noun -a, relation ka second noun phir -i.
فِي كِتَابِ الطَّالِبِ: preposition ke baad first noun bhi -i.
مَكْتَبَةُ الْمَدْرَسَةِ school library hai. Is simple type mein first noun ki ta marbuta connected t ke saath parhi jati hai.

examples.meaningRomanUrdu: Main ne student ki kitaab parhi.

lessons.title: Adjective agreement and non-human plurals
objectives: Understand and use the taught adjective agreement and non-human plurals patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Simple descriptive noun phrase mein adjective gender, number, definiteness aur case se noun ko match karta hai. Lekin non-human plural ki common agreement feminine singular hoti hai: كُتُبٌ جَدِيدَةٌ. Human plural aur non-human plural ko aik hi automatic rule se na parhen.
rulesRomanUrdu: قَلَمٌ جَدِيدٌ aur حَقِيبَةٌ جَدِيدَةٌ singular gender match hain.
الْقَلَمُ الْجَدِيدُ definite descriptive phrase hai; الْقَلَمُ جَدِيدٌ statement hai.
الْكُتُبُ الْجَدِيدَةُ = the new books; books non-human plural, adjective feminine singular.
فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ الْجَدِيدَةِ mein preposition ke baad noun aur adjective dono genitive hain.

objectives: Understand and use the taught dual and sound plurals in context patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Dual aur sound plurals ki endings role ke saath badalti hain. الطَّالِبَانِ do male students subject form; الطَّالِبَيْنِ object/genitive form. Sound masculine plural ـُونَ versus ـِينَ aur sound feminine plural ka accusative kasra bhi dekhen.
rulesRomanUrdu: جَاءَ الطَّالِبَانِ: subject dual -aani; رَأَيْتُ الطَّالِبَيْنِ: object dual -ayni.
الْمُعَلِّمُونَ subject aur إِلَى الْمُعَلِّمِينَ genitive male/mixed teachers.
رَأَيْتُ الْمُعَلِّمَاتِ: sound feminine plural object par kasra, fatha nahin.
Yeh shown case forms ko sentence role se jorti hain; har plural sound pattern nahin, broken plurals alag seekhen.

objectives: Understand and use the taught imperatives for common classroom actions patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Command ya direct request ke liye imperative use hota hai. اُكْتُبْ write (aik mard), اُكْتُبِي one woman aur اُكْتُبُوا male/mixed group forms hain. Lehja/context mein direct command aur polite request ka farq samjhen; roleplay fictional classroom tak mahdood hai.
rulesRomanUrdu: اُكْتُبْ / اُكْتُبِي / اُكْتُبُوا addressed number/gender ke saath badalte hain.
اِفْتَحْ open aur اِجْلِسْ sit ki taught singular forms hain; initial vowel har verb mein same nahin.
اُكْتُبُوا mein final alif likha hai, alag aa awaaz nahin.
مِنْ فَضْلِكَ ya مِنْ فَضْلِكِ request ko polite bana sakta hai; grammar pattern ko real consent/context se alag na samjhen.

reading.text: قَالَ الْمُعَلِّمُ: اُكْتُبُوا الْعُنْوَانَ. اُكْتُبْ جُمْلَةً يَا خَالِدُ. اُكْتُبِي سُؤَالًا يَا سَارَةُ. ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الطُّلَّابُ مَا كَتَبُوا.

lessons.title: Do not: prohibition versus a negative fact
objectives: Understand and use the taught do not: prohibition versus a negative fact patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: لَا negative statement bhi bana sakti hai aur mana karne ka pattern bhi. أَنْتَ لَا تَكْتُبُ you do not write aik fact; لَا تَكْتُبْ do not write aik prohibition hai. Prohibitive laa ke baad mudari jussive hota hai; shown regular form mein final sukoon dekhen.
rulesRomanUrdu: لَا تَكْتُبْ masculine singular prohibition; تَكْتُبُ indicative negative fact se farq hai.
لَا تَكْتُبِي one woman aur لَا تَكْتُبُوا group mein afal khamsa ki noon drop hoti hai.
لَا تَفْتَحْ الْبَابَ = darwaza na kholen.
Yeh fictional instructions hain; commands ko real-world safety ya professional advice ke taur par na lein. Mood/weak verb tafseel B1 mein hogi.

reading.text: فِي هٰذَا التَّدْرِيبِ قَالَ الْمُعَلِّمُ: لَا تَكْتُبُوا عَلَى الْكِتَابِ. اُكْتُبُوا فِي الدَّفْتَرِ. أَمَّا خَالِدٌ فَهُوَ لَا يَكْتُبُ الْآنَ؛ هُوَ يَقْرَأُ.

lessons.title: Past states with kana
objectives: Understand and use the taught past states with kana patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Present noun sentence ko past state se jorne ke liye كَانَ use ho sakta hai. الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ house is large; كَانَ الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرًا house was large. Kana ke baad subject nominative rehta hai aur descriptive predicate accusative hota hai.
rulesRomanUrdu: كَانَ الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرًا mein baytu -u aur kabiiran -an role ka farq dikhate hain.
كَانَتِ الْمَدْرَسَةُ كَبِيرَةً feminine subject ke liye hai. Connected speech mein kanat ki taa yahan kasra leti hai.
كُنْتُ طَالِبًا = main male student tha; كُنْتُ طَالِبَةً female speaker thi.
كُنَّا هُنَا hum yahan thay. Adverb/location predicate ko har baar tanween wale adjective jaisa na banayen.

reading.text: كُنْتُ طَالِبًا فِي هٰذِهِ الْمَدْرَسَةِ. كَانَ الْبَيْتُ قَرِيبًا. كَانَتِ الْمَكْتَبَةُ صَغِيرَةً. الْآنَ الْمَكْتَبَةُ كَبِيرَةٌ، وَأَنَا مُعَلِّمٌ.
reading.meaningRomanUrdu: Main is school mein male student tha. Ghar qareeb tha aur library chhoti thi. Ab library bari hai aur main teacher hoon.

lessons.title: Relative clauses with alladhi and allati
objectives: Understand and use the taught relative clauses with alladhi and allati patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Relative clause kisi definite noun ko mazeed pehchan deti hai. الَّذِي singular masculine aur الَّتِي singular feminine hain. هٰذَا الطَّالِبُ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ yeh woh male student hai jo parhta hai. Relatives ko gender aur reference ke saath seekhen.
rulesRomanUrdu: Subject-relative example: الطَّالِبُ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ, student who reads.
Object-relative mein return pronoun zaroori ho sakta hai: الْكِتَابُ الَّذِي قَرَأْتُهُ, the book that I read.
الطَّالِبَةُ الَّتِي تَقْرَأُ feminine reference hai.
Simple indefinite noun ko isi definite pattern se automatically na joren; definite/indefinite relationship ki applied practice B1 mein hogi.

examples.meaningRomanUrdu: Yeh woh male student hai jo parhta hai.
Yeh woh female student hai jo likhti hai.

Jo message main ne likha woh chhota hai.

lessons.title: Vocabulary families without guessing meanings

lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Root family words ke darmiyan relation yaad rakhne mein madad deti hai. ك ت ب se كَتَبَ، كِتَابٌ، كَاتِبٌ aur مَكْتَبَةٌ ki taught family dekhen. Lekin common root se har word ka exact meaning, register ya frequency khud sabit nahin hota.

Pattern aur root ko learning links ki tarah use karen; har mathematically possible word real usage nahin.
Yahan koi religious text, corpus frequency ya unsourced word count nahin. Dictionary/search functions later milestone ka kaam hain.

lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Chhote connected account mein sequence, reason aur result ko clear rakhen. أَوَّلًا first, ثُمَّ then, لِأَنَّ because aur لِذٰلِكَ therefore reader ko events ka relation samjhate hain. Sirf connectors ki tadaad achhi writing ya grammar grade nahin hoti.
rulesRomanUrdu: أَوَّلًا aur ثُمَّ sequence dete hain; dono ko same event ki contradictory tartib ke liye na use karen.
لِأَنَّ reason introduce karta hai; لِأَنَّ الْمَكْتَبَةَ قَرِيبَةٌ mein noun accusative hai.
لِذٰلِكَ result/consequence ko jorta hai; reason aur result ko alag pehchanen.
Writing ko explicit Save paragraph se save karen. Checklist learner ki apni review hai, automatic correction nahin.
